title: Frontend
blurb: How browsers work: HTML/CSS/JS, rendering, web APIs, performance and security.

quiz.question: What does the defer attribute on a script tag do?
options: Runs the script before HTML parsing
Downloads in parallel and executes after parsing finishes, in document order
Executes as soon as it downloads, in any order
quiz.explanation: defer scripts don't block parsing and run in order before DOMContentLoaded; async scripts run as soon as they arrive, out of order — fine for independent scripts such as analytics.

quiz.question: Which Core Web Vital measures responsiveness to user input?
quiz.explanation: Interaction to Next Paint (INP) replaced FID in March 2024. LCP measures loading, CLS measures visual stability; TTFB is a diagnostic metric.

quiz.question: The best defence against stored XSS when rendering user content is…
options: Escaping/encoding output for its context (plus a Content Security Policy)
quiz.explanation: Encode user data for the context it's placed in (HTML, attribute, URL, JS); frameworks do this by default. Sanitize if you must render HTML, and add a CSP as defence in depth.

quiz.question: What does CORS protect?
options: Users: it controls whether a browser lets a page read responses from another origin
quiz.explanation: CORS is a browser-enforced relaxation of the same-origin policy. It isn't server-side access control; non-browser clients ignore it.

quiz.question: Which change most often causes layout shift (CLS)?
options: Images and embeds without reserved dimensions
quiz.explanation: Give images, video and ads explicit width/height or aspect-ratio, and avoid inserting content above existing content, so the browser can reserve space.

quiz.question: Which element should a "Delete" action that does not navigate use?
quiz.explanation: Buttons perform actions, links navigate. A button gives keyboard support and the right semantics for free.

quiz.question: Why is a placeholder not a substitute for a <label>?
options: Placeholders are not supported on mobile
It disappears when typing and is not reliably announced as the field name
quiz.explanation: Visible labels give an accessible name and stay visible.

quiz.question: Best tool for a two-dimensional page layout with header, sidebar, main and footer?
quiz.explanation: Grid controls rows and columns together. Flexbox is for one-dimensional flow.

quiz.question: What do cascade layers (@layer) mainly solve?
options: Specificity wars, by ordering groups of rules regardless of selector weight
quiz.explanation: Later layers win over earlier ones, whatever the specificity.

quiz.question: Why use npm ci instead of npm install in CI?
options: It installs exactly what the lockfile specifies and fails if it is out of sync
quiz.explanation: Reproducible installs prevent "works on my machine" problems.

quiz.question: Which value is safe to expose through VITE_ environment variables?
quiz.explanation: Frontend environment variables are compiled into public JavaScript.

quiz.question: Which change most directly reduces CLS?
options: Setting width/height or aspect-ratio on images and reserving space for banners
quiz.explanation: Layout shifts come from content without reserved space.

quiz.question: What is a good caching policy for hashed assets like app.3f9a2c.js?
quiz.explanation: The hash changes when the content changes, so these files can be cached forever.

problems.title: Fix a slow LCP
problems.prompt: A landing page's hero image is the LCP element and takes 4 s. List five fixes.
problems.solution: Serve a correctly sized, compressed AVIF/WebP via srcset/sizes; don't lazy-load the hero; add fetchpriority="high" (or a preload) so it's discovered early; serve it from a CDN; cut render-blocking CSS/JS and improve TTFB (caching, SSR/SSG). Re-measure with field data (CrUX/RUM), not just a lab run.

problems.title: Accessible modal
problems.prompt: List the behaviours an accessible modal dialog needs.
problems.solution: Use the native <dialog> element with showModal() (or role=dialog + aria-modal), label it with aria-labelledby, move focus into it on open and trap focus inside, close on Escape, make the background inert, and return focus to the triggering element on close.

problems.title: Fix a slow LCP
problems.prompt: A marketing page has an LCP of 4.5 s on mobile. The hero is a 1.4 MB JPEG and the page is client-rendered. Plan the fixes.
problems.solution: Server-render or prerender the HTML, serve the hero as AVIF/WebP with srcset and explicit dimensions, set fetchpriority=high and preload it, never lazy-load it, inline the critical CSS, defer non-critical JS and third-party scripts, and cache the HTML at the CDN. Then measure again with Lighthouse and field data.

problems.title: Accessible checkout form
problems.prompt: Rewrite a checkout form that uses placeholders, a div as its submit button and red borders for errors.
problems.solution: Add visible labels linked with for/id, input types and autocomplete, fieldsets for groups, a real submit button, and text errors linked with aria-describedby plus aria-invalid. Move focus to the first error on submit, and validate on the server too.
